title.en: Renew a fully managed Flink workspace

descriptions.zh: **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解flink全托管产品的收费方式和[价格](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/flink/product-overview/renewal-policy)**
descriptions.en: **Before you use this operation, review the billing method and [pricing](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/flink/product-overview/renewal-policy) for fully managed Flink.**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun foasconsole renew-instance --biz-region cn-beijing --instance-id sc_flinkserverless_public_cn-7e22ae5sess --duration 1 --pricing-cycle Month --use-promotion-code true --promotion-code example-string --api-version 2021-10-28 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun foasconsole RenewInstance --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'sc_flinkserverless_public_cn-7e22ae5sess' --PricingCycle Month --PromotionCode 'example-string' --Region 'cn-beijing' --Duration 1 --UsePromotionCode true
